question: In which season is Sarhul celebrated in Jharkhand?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Spring.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the Indian state of** Jharkhand,** there is a** spring festival called Sarhul.**
 
• The festival is observed for **three days**, from **Chaitra Purnima** until the** third day of the Chaitra month **in **Sukla Paksh.**
 
• **Pahan, the village priest, sacrifices flowers, fruit, vermilion, a rooster, and tapan to the Sun, the local deity and ancestor,** during the celebration in order to bring the **village good fortune.**
 
• Then the villagers dance while **clutching sal tree blooms.**
 
• It serves as a reminder that a** new year has begun.**
 
• According to tradition, the marriage of the Earth and the Sun is also symbolized by it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The festival's **Nagpuri name is Sarhul.**
 
• **The sal tree in Nagpuri is called Sar or Sarai, and Hul means "together" and ****"grove."**
 
• Sal represents a **celebration of nature.**
 
• **Kurukh and Sadan** celebrate Sarhul, a significant holiday. It is referred to as** Khaddi in Kurukh.**
 
• The **Bhumijs and Mundas **call it **Hadi Bonga.**
 
• The **Ho and Santal people** refer to it as **Baha parab.**
